name: Multi-surface publishing kit
audience: Technical editors, newsletter writers and engineering advocates
sourcePolicy: Shared corpus only; each surface adapted independently within this experiment; no external research and no other experiment output
workflow: Pair frames with contextual captions rather than decontextualized quotes
goodEnoughDefinition: The kit offers immediately usable editorial starting points across formats while preventing common attribution, compression and incident-generalization errors.
reviewChecks: Five posts do not repeat one hook
